before-after.summary: Browser-openable before/after artifacts for visual behavior, benchmark deltas, and feature tours. Registered after repeated personal use across wterm work; no baseline comparison has been completed.

issue-intake.summary: Canonical contributor-side intake gate. It qualifies a bounded shortlist, keeps the final choice human, optionally uses xref as graph evidence, and seeds the Issue Contract without owning reproduction or implementation.

pick-an-issue.summary: Self-contained compatibility alias for issue-intake during the v0.0.4 migration window. Existing invocations keep working, but new workflows should use the canonical name.

record-a-case.summary: Used to capture real public maintenance work and backfills as evidence ledgers. Promoted to the stable distribution surface; it has not completed a baseline comparison.

review-gate.summary: Pre-review gate harvested from maintainer review rounds across agent-browser and portless cases. Blind replication round 002 compared the method against an answer key and exposed both catches and verification losses.

trail-decisions.summary: Append-only decision trail written to the canonical Foundry during implementation so review can audit choices, not only the diff. Redesigned after the lifecycle audit and awaiting one real dogfood run.

signature-repro.summary: Niche triage for bugs that require unavailable hardware or platforms, using structural or visual signatures on available machines. Retained as Candidate only for that boundary and awaiting a baseline eval round.

handoff.summary: End-of-cycle handoff derived from twelve hand-written handoffs across vcut, petdex, portless, wterm, gateway-spend, and agent-browser. Three required sections, read-only state verification, and stacked sessions. Supersedes the retired session-handoff template and awaits its first dogfood run.

quality-baseline.summary: Read-only repository quality baseline. Frozen outside the default issue workflow until a real quality-baseline request supplies dogfood evidence.

performance-proof.summary: Measurement-first performance workflow. Frozen outside the default issue workflow and invoked only for an evidenced performance claim.

test-strength.summary: Test effectiveness workflow using falsification, mutation, properties, real boundaries, and artifact checks. Retained as the proof-successor candidate and awaiting comparison against archived Unfold Review and no-skill baselines.

resilience-audit.summary: Failure-path audit. Frozen outside the default issue workflow and invoked only when timeout, cancellation, retry, cleanup, overload, or concurrency risk triggers it.

solution-gate.summary: Gates the shape of a fix before it is written or adopted: blind cross-family proposals, discriminating probes, failure-shape scoring, candidate audit, and compact evidence-preserving visuals. Dogfooded on greenfield fixes and one retrospective candidate audit; no baseline comparison yet.
